sanskrit: ete vai priyāś cāpriyāś ca rtvijaḥ svargaṃ lokaṃ gamayanti yad atithayaḥ ||
english: These indeed — both the beloved and the unloved — are the officiating priests who lead one to the heavenly world, namely the guests (atithis).

sanskrit: yat kṣattāraṃ hvayaty ā śrāvayati yat pratiśṛṇoti praty ā śrāvayati ||
english: When he summons the doorkeeper and causes him to be called, and when he responds and causes the response to be heard in return.

sanskrit: yat pariveṣṭāra āvasathān prapadyante camasādhvaryava eva te teṣāṃ naikaś canāhotā ||
english: When the servers enter the lodging-places, they are in truth the cup-bearing adhvaryus for those guests — not a single one of them is without the function of an hotṛ.

sanskrit: yat prātar upaharati prātaḥsavanam eva tat ||
english: What one brings forth in the morning — that is verily the morning pressing (prātaḥsavana).

sanskrit: yad dīvopaharati mādhyaṃdinam eva tat savanam ||
english: What one brings forth at midday — that is verily the midday pressing (mādhyaṃdina savana).

sanskrit: yat sāyam upaharati tṛtīyasavanam eva tat ||
english: What one brings forth in the evening — that is verily the third pressing (tṛtīya savana).

sanskrit: yad atithipatir atithīn pariviṣyāsanaṃ yācate avabhṛtham eva tad upāvaiti ||
english: When the lord of the guests, having served the guests all round, asks leave of his seat — he thereby approaches the avabhṛtha (the concluding ablution of the sacrifice).

sanskrit: yat sabhāgayati dakṣiṇām eva tat sabhāgayati yad anutiṣṭhaty udavasyaty eva tat ||
english: What he distributes in common — thereby he distributes the sacrificial fee (dakṣiṇā); and what he follows through to completion — thereby he indeed performs the udavasāna (final rite of dismissal).

sanskrit: sa upahūtaḥ pṛthivyāṃ bhakṣayaty upahūtas tasmin yat pṛthivyāṃ viśvarūpam | pṛthivyāṃ tapati pṛthivyām ā bhāti svargaloko bhavati ya evaṃ veda ||
english: He, being invoked, feasts upon the earth; invoked, he feasts upon whatever all-form (viśvarūpa) exists in the earth. He blazes within the earth, he shines forth upon the earth. He becomes the heavenly world — he who knows thus.

sanskrit: sa upahūto antarikṣe bhakṣayaty upahūtas tasmin yad antarikṣe viśvarūpam | antarikṣe tapaty antarikṣa ā bhāti (…) ||
english: He, being invoked, feasts upon the atmosphere; invoked, he feasts upon whatever all-form exists in the atmosphere. He blazes within the atmosphere, he shines forth upon the atmosphere. [He becomes the heavenly world — he who knows thus.]

sanskrit: sa upahūto divi bhakṣayaty upahūtas tasmin yad divi viśvarūpam | divi tapati divy ā bhāti (…) ||
english: He, being invoked, feasts upon the sky; invoked, he feasts upon whatever all-form exists in the sky. He blazes within the sky, he shines forth upon the sky. [He becomes the heavenly world — he who knows thus.]

sanskrit: sa upahūto deveṣu bhakṣayaty upahūtas tasmin yad deveṣu viśvarūpam | deveṣu tapati deveṣv ā bhāti (…) ||
english: He, being invoked, feasts among the gods; invoked, he feasts upon whatever all-form exists among the gods. He blazes among the gods, he shines forth among the gods. [He becomes the heavenly world — he who knows thus.]

sanskrit: sa upahūto lokeṣu bhakṣayaty upahūtas tasmin yal lokeṣu viśvarūpam | lokeṣu tapati lokeṣv ā bhāti svargaloko bhavati ya evaṃ veda ||
english: He, being invoked, feasts among the worlds; invoked, he feasts upon whatever all-form exists in the worlds. He blazes among the worlds, he shines forth among the worlds. He becomes the heavenly world — he who knows thus.

sanskrit: yat prāṅ āsīno virvapati yajñāya ca devebhyaś cā vṛścate ||
english: When, seated facing east, one scatters the grain — thereby one cuts off a portion for the sacrifice and for the gods.

sanskrit: yad dakṣiṇāsīno nirvapati yamāya ca pitṛbhyaś cā vṛścate ||
english: When, seated facing south, one scatters the grain — thereby one cuts off a portion for Yama and for the ancestors (pitṛs).

sanskrit: yat pratyaṅ āsīno nirvapati varuṇāyāpsuṣada ā vṛścate ||
english: When, seated facing west, one scatters the grain — thereby one cuts off a portion for Varuṇa, the one who dwells in the waters (apsuṣad).

sanskrit: yad udaṅ āsīno nirvapati somāya ca rājñe saptaṛṣibhyaś cāvṛścate ||
english: When, seated facing north, one scatters the grain — thereby one cuts off a portion for Soma the king and for the Seven Seers (saptarṣis).

sanskrit: yad upasthaṃ kṛtvāsīno nirvapati vāyave cāntarikṣāya cā vṛścate ||
english: When, seated with the lap formed, one scatters the grain — thereby one cuts off a portion for Vāyu and for the atmosphere (antarikṣa).

sanskrit: yad ūrdhvas tiṣṭhan nirvapati dive cādityāya cāvṛścate ||
english: When, standing upright, one scatters the grain — thereby one cuts off a portion for the sky (dyu) and for Āditya.
